posts.summary_en: Season 1's final screen, two hours before the close: #1 슈퍼땅콩 7,292, #2 凱凱の餅乾軍團 7,264, #3 살라딘 7,048; the poster is 101st at 3,804 in Elite Master 1. A reply: 100th was 3,805.
Season 1's end: 3,034 points ranked 407th; a reply puts 2,688 at 1,884th, both in Elite Master 1.
With the shop bought out and the top 100 out of reach, stop at Elite Master 1-2. A reply: 101st and 2,000th get the same reward.

posts.title_en: So I just copy the current Rumble #1 deck?
posts.summary_en: Season 2's first night. Replies read the #1 deck: no Herb; Chardonnay gives Volley, the buffed Rockstar shields fast, and Cheesecake now gets pierce; an Oven-Bari deck that can't one-shot is pointless anyway. Another: Herb has been dead in Arena for a while.

quotes.en: Herb has been in the coffin in Arena for a while

posts.title_en: Why does the Rumble shop reset only every two seasons?
posts.summary_en: The title states the shop resets every two seasons; it didn't reset for Season 2. dc:83889: 'it's a four-week shop', with the timer shown.
rules: The Rumble medal shop resets every two seasons (four weeks); not at Season 2's start.

quotes.en: No, this one is a four-week shop

posts.title_en: Wasn't the Rumble shop supposed to reset?
posts.summary_en: The poster expected a reset on 10-09; replies: a four-week shop, see the remaining time at the bottom.

posts.title_en: Rumble is an Oven all-in meta now?
posts.summary_en: Frog pets (Floral Froglet) are spreading on the ranking. Reply: Chardonnay raised the value of crit DMG, and Bari and Oven are both Fire, hence the Fire crit DMG pet. 'One-shot meta'.
mechanics: Floral Froglet (+28% crit DMG to Fire allies) pays because Bari and Oven are Fire and Chardonnay floods crit.

quotes.kr: 샤르도네 때문에 치피 밸류가 많이 올라갔고 바리오방덱에서 바리오방 둘 다 불속성이라서 개구리펫 많이 쓰나보네
quotes.en: Chardonnay raised crit DMG's value, and Bari and Oven are both Fire, so frog pets are popular

posts.title_en: Rumble has no attacker advantage, right?
posts.summary_en: Replies guess Rumble has it too. No test.

posts.title_en: A Korean took Rumble #1 in the end
posts.summary_en: Season 1's final minutes. Replies: the leader was swarmed; revenge gives risk-free points, and attackers are favoured in both modes because defenses are fixed and attackers see them.
mechanics: Revenge and fixed defenses favour the attacker in both modes (replies).
